identity.title: Bootstrap Activation Invariant Repair
identity.objective: Repair the governed Ubuntu bootstrap of the merged parent S10-DEPLOY-EXEC-01 (PR #214) after the real Phase-B STOP BOOTSTRAP_ACTIVATION_DEFECT so that (1) package installation cannot contaminate the immutable release (RELEASE_FILE_SET_MISMATCH: pip built in-tree, leaving build/ and *.egg-info), (2) the polymarket runtime user can execute the installed venv (RUNTIME_VENV_NOT_EXECUTABLE: umask 027 left the root-created venv unreadable, 203/EXEC) while never being able to write it, and (3) the bootstrap fails closed before activation if either invariant is false. No verifier weakening, no host hand patch, no new authority; Phase B stays suspended until merge and fresh authorization.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-DEPLOY-EXEC-01R. The bootstrap returns to the merged parent install mechanism (known defective on a real host) and the repair status/spec artifacts disappear. runtime_baseline.py, the release verifier, systemd units, slices, dependencies and workflows are untouched; no host, store, order or capital state is touched by this repository repair.

api_matrix.reason: Bootstrap shell repair only; no runtime_baseline.py subcommand, verifier or product API changes.

semantic_fields.reason: These rules close the two repaired activation invariants, their fail-closed ordering and the unchanged verifier and authority posture.

items.required_rule: pip installs the project into the target release venv only from a disposable mktemp copy (/tmp/polymarket-install-source.*) of the already-verified pristine incoming release, never from the immutable target release; the copy is removed on PASS and via the EXIT trap on every FAIL.
items.validation_rule: Behavioral POSIX harness with simulated in-tree build debris proves the target and pristine trees stay debris-free and every disposable source is removed on PASS and FAIL.
items.safe_output: closed bootstrap JSON status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: After the read-only lock and before unit verification, firewall gates and the atomic current switch, verify-release --allow-activation-artifacts on the target release must return RELEASE_VERIFIED, otherwise POST_INSTALL_RELEASE_VERIFY_FAILED.
items.validation_rule: Ordering regression plus activated-release verifier regression.
items.safe_output: closed bootstrap JSON status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: The release verifier is unchanged: only the governed .venv and the exact local_data symlink are activation artifacts; build/ and *.egg-info in the target release remain RELEASE_FILE_SET_MISMATCH.
items.validation_rule: runtime_baseline.py is outside the exact scope; regression asserts debris stays rejected.
items.safe_output: closed bootstrap JSON status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: After pip check the target release is normalized chmod -R go+rX,go-w (root-owned, runtime readable/traversable/executable, never runtime-writable) and then locked chmod -R a-w.
items.validation_rule: Behavioral POSIX harness asserts read/traverse/execute bits and zero write bits on every entry.
items.safe_output: closed bootstrap JSON status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: Before activation runuser -u polymarket must execute the target venv python in isolated mode and resolve polymarket-strategy-lab metadata, otherwise RUNTIME_VENV_NOT_EXECUTABLE; runuser and mktemp are in the required-command gate.
items.validation_rule: Harness proves the exact guard invocation and the closed fail-closed code.
items.safe_output: closed bootstrap JSON status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: No host hand patch, credential, account, signing, order, capital, live, workflow, dependency, src/ or runtime_baseline.py change; Phase B stays suspended until merge and fresh authorization.
items.validation_rule: Exact five-path diff; authority mirror; status entry.
items.safe_output: closed bootstrap JSON status or closed error_code
